doc.digest: Segment audio and reorder it on looped playback
doc.description: chucker~ takes a specified amount of audio data, stores the data in an internal buffer, divides the buffered data into equal sections, and allows the sections to be reordered on playback.

inlets.description: The right inlet of the object accepts a signal input in the range 0. - 1.0 (typically from the right outlet of a groove~ object) to control the playback of the object's buffered contents.

outlets.digest: signal: Out left outlet: The segmented and reordered playback of the left channel of the chucker~ object's buffered contents.

outlets.description: signal: Out middle outlet: The segmented and reordered playback of the right channel of the chucker~ object's buffered contents.

signal: Out right outlet: The current step number in the playback cycle is sent out the right outlet as a signal value.
				
				Note: This is the step number, not the index of the segment being played back.

methods.name: directions
methods.description:
The word directions, followed by a 1 or 2 to indicate left or right channel and a list of integer values whose length is equal to the number of steps, sets the direction of playback for the sections. Playback direction is specified as follows:
				
				
				1: forward (the default)
				
				0: mute
				
				-1: reverse

methods.name: fademode
methods.description:
Sets the fade method for segment smoothing. Modes include:
				
				0: Classic (same as Max 5)
				
				1: Pre-fade (fades use buffered audio, fade executes prior to segment transition)
				
				2: Post-fade (fades use buffered audio, fade executes after segment transition)

methods.name: freeze
methods.digest: Loop the current buffer segment on playback
methods.description: The message freeze 1 causes the current buffer segment to loop on playback. Sending the message freeze 0 resumes normal playback.

methods.name: nstep
methods.digest: Set the number of buffer segments
methods.description: The word nsteps, followed by an integer in the range 1 - 64, sets the number of equal portions into which the chucker~ object's internal buffer is segmented for playback.

methods.name: signal
methods.description:
In left inlet: Left channel audio input.
				
				In middle inlet: Right channel audio input.
				
				In right inlet: An audio signal in the range 0. - 1.0 provides the audio sync input. This task is typically done using a phasor~ object's output as input.

methods.name: smooth
methods.digest: Set a crossfade amount between segments
methods.description: The word smooth, followed by a floating point number in the range 0. - 1.0, sets an amount of smoothing (crossfading) between the individual segments being reordered for playback.

methods.name: steps
methods.digest: Set the playback order for the sections
methods.description:
The word steps, followed by a 1 or 2 to indicate left or right channel and a list of integer values whose range is between 1 and the number of steps and whose length is equal to the number of steps, sets the order of playback for the sections.
				
				e.g. the message steps 1 4 3 2 1, steps 2 1 2 3 4, when sent to a chucker~ object whose number of steps is set to 4, will play the four left channel segments in reverse order, and the right channel in regular order. order
